svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The assistant side, in four layers
svg.desc: Four layers, each resting on the one below. At the bottom, the referee: the study tool and its checks, with no language model. On it, the roles as files: coordinating, analysis, review and curating. On those, the knowledge: a wiki read before work and drafted for after it, which a person signs. At the top, a runner, which starts a role with its tools. Two rules run through all four: a tool, never an assistant, decides whether a step counts; and nothing a role needs lives only in a platform's settings.
svg.text: runners/claude-code starts a role with its tools; runners/by-hand checks one command at a time
a wiki of Markdown pages (openwiki/): read before work, drafted for after it; a person signs
assistants/: coordinating, analysis, review, curating; in a form no agent platform owns
tools/sf.py and its checks: no language model decides anything
Two rules run through all four:
a tool, never an assistant, decides whether a step counts;
nothing a role needs lives only in a platform's settings.
